library.title: Grading schemes
library.intro: A scheme turns points into the grade students see: a percent, a band, pass/fail or a scaled ORT score. Built-in schemes are shared; your own schemes can be used in all your courses.
library.emptyMine: You have no schemes of your own yet. Create one, or duplicate a built-in scheme.

typeSummaries.percent: Shows the share of points as a percent.
typeSummaries.bands: Maps the percent to named bands, such as 5, 4, 3, 2.
typeSummaries.pass_fail: Pass at or above a threshold percent.
typeSummaries.piecewise_curve: Converts the share of points to a scale, like the ORT 60–245.
typeSummaries.lookup_table: Looks up each raw score in a table you paste.

typeHints.points: The grade is the number of points earned (after any late deduction or manual grade). You can add a pass threshold.
typeHints.percent: The grade is points earned ÷ points possible × 100. You can add a pass threshold.
typeHints.bands: Each band starts at a minimum percent. List bands from the highest down; the last band must start at 0 %.
typeHints.pass_fail: The student passes when the percent is at or above the threshold.
typeHints.piecewise_curve: The share of points r = raw ÷ possible is converted segment by segment. The segments must run from r = 0 to r = 1 without gaps.
typeHints.lookup_table: Each row maps a range of raw points to a value. Rows must start at 0, go up without overlaps or gaps, and reach the expected maximum.

fields.passThresholdHint: Students at or above this percent pass.

bands.label: Label
bands.hint: The key is stored with each grade; the label is what students see in their language.

curve.formulaHint: Inside a segment from r₀ to r₁ the value goes from v₀ to v₁; k = 1 is a straight line, k > 1 bends down, k < 1 bends up.
curve.hint: A full score always gets the scale maximum.

lookup.label: Label

validation.sdPositive: the standard deviation must be greater than 0
validation.minMax: the lowest value must not be above the highest
validation.scaleOrder: the scale minimum must be below the maximum
validation.keyTooLong: the key is too long (at most 32 characters)
validation.labelRequired: enter a label in at least one language
validation.labelTooLong: the label is too long (at most 60 characters)
validation.bandsOrder: the percent must be lower than in the band above
validation.bandsLastZero: the last band must start at 0 %
validation.segmentsStart: the first segment must start at r = 0
validation.segmentsEnd: the last segment must end at r = 1
validation.segmentsGap: must start where the previous segment ends
validation.exponentPositive: the exponent must be greater than 0
validation.rowsStart: the first row must start at 0
validation.rowsOverlap: overlaps the previous row or is out of order
validation.rowsGap: leaves a gap after the previous row
validation.rowsCoverage: the rows must reach the expected maximum
